description: An open cardboard box sits on a green-covered table, with a small black case, a yellow rubber duck, a small block, and an orange-and-blue toy nearby. The right hand reaches in from the right, picks up the black case and places it into the open box, then adds the rubber duck, the small block, and finally the orange-and-blue toy; after that, both hands grasp the box and fold the lid down to close it, releasing once it’s shut.
